name: ecommerce-promotions-livewire
description: The shopper-facing surface of Promotions: a code entry field and a display of what the applied offers took off, re-quoted on every basket change and never cached.
features: A shopper-facing promotion code field whose only writable property is the code string
An applied-offer display rendered from the domain's own Money and per-line allocation
Every refusal answered with one message, so the field is not an oracle for which codes exist
The entitlement re-quoted on every render and on every basket-changed event, never held as state
No money value accepted as client input: the basket is an opaque reference the server prices
An optional basket-resolution seam whose absence removes the display rather than failing the page
